name: Report Synthesis
intent: Generate a concise evidence-grounded report from provided notes without overstating unsupported claims.

source.text: Synthesize provided notes into a structured report. Include required sections, state evidence limits, and end with actionable next steps. Do not invent evidence.

inputs.description: A set of observations, measurements, or meeting notes.

outputs.description: A report with summary, evidence, and next steps.

steps.title: Read notes
steps.description: Identify the provided evidence, missing evidence, and requested audience.

steps.title: Structure report
steps.description: Create required sections such as summary, evidence, and next steps.

steps.title: Write report
steps.description: Write a concise report that distinguishes evidence from inference.

rules.sourceText: Include summary, evidence, and next steps.
Do not invent evidence or hide uncertainty.

rules.normalizedForm: An actionable next step is mentioned.

checks.name: Required sections present
checks.assertion: The response includes summary, evidence, and next step sections.

checks.name: Evidence limitations stated
checks.assertion: The response distinguishes evidence from inference or states limitations.

checks.name: Actionable next step stated
checks.assertion: The response includes at least one actionable next step.
